description: Having a low tyre pressure would increase the wear and tear of your tyres. We have a solution! Designed not only to measure tyre pressures, Groz Heavy Duty Analog Tyre Inflator Gauge inflates and deflates tyres of cars and other light vehicles as and when required. Activate tyre deflation via the deflation valve on the gun body which is made from Brass in order to prevent it from rust. A simple press of the valve will activate it and reduce pressure. For accuracy, we have ascertained that it is +/-3-2-3% accurate with the resolution of 1 PSI across the maximum pressure up to 60 PSI. It measures in 2 units, i.e., PSI & BAR.
